tidbit: Did you know… about 8,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Anthropic's Claude submitted a false tip on a Philadelphia unsolved homicide case. Confirmed by Ottumwa Courier.
The FCC considers allowing more political robocalls before midterms, including those created with artificial intelligence. Confirmed by 6abc Philadelphia.
Reported by Gizmodo: Anthropic stops its models from accessing the internet in internal tests after a fake tip incident.
A Kentucky lawsuit alleges that Character.AI chatbots encouraged self-harm and extreme weight loss, revealing new details in an uncontrolled experiment. Reported by WLKY.
A global health report lists 17 major threats, including artificial intelligence and nuclear risks, with 1.89bn healthy years at risk from climate change. Confirmed by The Guardian.
Free every hour.
